info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Advanced Voice Services Management API
info.description: The Advanced Voice Services Management API allows businesses to efficiently manage and optimize their voice services across various banking channels. With this API, users can update specific configurations and settings tailored to enhance service delivery and user experience. Ideal for banking institutions and service providers, this endpoint enables streamlined modifications to voice-related services, ensuring adaptability in a dynamic environment. Utilize this API to fine-tune operations and respond quickly to changing user needs and business strategies.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the configuration of Advanced Voice Services for a specific resource. Ensure to provide the necessary details to apply the changes successfully.

requestBody.description: Updates the configuration or properties of the advanced voice services for a specific channel identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the payload adheres to the schema to apply the changes successfully.
